elevate.move: Turn the calculator into a real take-off sheet: drag handles on the drawn slab plan set length x width in feet, the plan re-cuts control joints live at <=10 ft panels, and the ticket below writes itself (sq ft, yards at 4/5/6 in., panel count, Sample total range) so 'Print this ticket' prints the homeowner's own driveway.

Make the hero ticket the protagonist instead of a side card: a sheet tilted 1-2 degrees that overlaps the next band by ~80px with its cross-section at full ticket width, stamped and ticked line by line on intro, so the first screen reads as one composed object and the left column's dead space becomes its shadow.
